description: The one text normalization for quotes and offsets: Unicode NFC, soft hyphens (U+00AD) dropped, every run of the listed whitespace one space. Offsets count code points. Mirrors: apps/web/src/tools/reader/reading/locator/text.ts and apps/workers/worker/tools/reader/locator.py.

cases.name: keeps leading and trailing single spaces
no-break and other Unicode spaces count as whitespace
BOM is whitespace on both sides
keeps zero-width joiners and ordinary hyphens
keeps code points outside the BMP
